data.name: Lawkush
data.gender_notes: Lawkush is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lawkush is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Kubera, who is the lord of wealth and prosperity. The name symbolizes abundance, generosity, and prosperity. The name Lawkush carries the meaning “God of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lawkush usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the blessings of wealth and prosperity, and share your blessings with others.
data.etymology: Lawkush belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lawkush total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Lawkush may symbolize the abundance and generosity of the universe and one's connection to the divine. It may also remind the bearer of the importance of being generous and sharing their blessings with others. Additionally, the name may serve as a reminder to focus on inner wealth and abundance, rather than solely material wealth.
